# Clarify | Target Customers

| Customer group | Relevant need |
| --- | --- |
| Primary customer profile | Founder sales, small B2B teams, and growing companies that want to control costs with AI usage without seats. |
| Decision makers and governance | Typical decision makers include business leaders, sales/HR leaders, operations leaders, and IT/security teams. Before purchasing, it is necessary to clarify the administrator, daily users, read-only users, external collaborators, and data owners at the same time to avoid underestimating the cost of seats, permissions, and change management. |
